inputs.text: Health sector workers in Nigeria protested at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday, opposing controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. The protest, involving the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations, came amid escalating tensions in the sector.
